question: State the set code of the set with release date of 07/13/2007?
clarification: Also keep rows that have no matching set_translations record.
gold: SELECT T2.setCode FROM sets AS T1 LEFT JOIN set_translations AS T2 ON T2.setCode = T1.code WHERE T1.releaseDate = '2007-07-13'
gold0: SELECT T2.setCode FROM sets AS T1 INNER JOIN set_translations AS T2 ON T2.setCode = T1.code WHERE T1.releaseDate = '2007-07-13'

d.request: State the set code of the set with a release date of 07/13/2007, and include the set even if it has no matching record in the set_translations table (i.e., keep rows with no matching set_translations record).
d.sql: SELECT s.code FROM sets s LEFT JOIN set_translations st ON st.setCode = s.code WHERE s.releaseDate = '2007-07-13'

b.request: Return the set code of every set released on 2007-07-13, using a left join to set_translations so that sets with no matching translation record are still included
b.sql: SELECT s.code FROM sets AS s LEFT JOIN set_translations AS st ON s.code = st.setCode WHERE s.releaseDate = '2007-07-13'

c.request:
State the set code of the set with release date of 07/13/2007?
Also keep rows that have no matching set_translations record.
c.sql: SELECT s.code, st.translation FROM sets s LEFT JOIN set_translations st ON st.setCode = s.code WHERE s.releaseDate = '2007-07-13'
